notes.title: Update 2.0 – Project Wunderwaffe: New Features and Improvements
notes.content:
[h3]We’re excited to present version 2.0 of Project Wunderwaffe! This update introduces significant changes and improvements to key game systems, making the gameplay experience even better.[/h3]

[h3][b]🔧 Production System Changes[/b][/h3]
[h3]:pwwenergy:Local Storage for Excess Resources[/h3]
[b]If warehouses are full, produced resources are no longer lost.[/b] Instead, they are stored locally in buildings or within a buffer. Notifications will now inform players about these events.
[h3]:pwwenergy:Flexible Production Queue[/h3]
The FIFO queue system has been removed. If one recipe lacks the required resources, the system will check for other recipes that can still be produced. This allows for more dynamic production management.
[h3]:pwwenergy:Improved Resource Retrieval from Warehouses[/h3]
The system now optimizes resource retrieval, speeding up production tasks.
[h3]:pwwenergy:Enhanced Recipe Tooltips[/h3]
Tooltips now include information about available resources, making production planning much easier.

[h3][b]📦 Warehouse Improvements[/b][/h3]
Resources in warehouses are now displayed alphabetically, improving organization and making inventory management more intuitive.

[h3][b]🔨 Mining System Changes[/b][/h3]
:pwwenergy:resource extraction speed decreases as mines get deeper,
:pwwenergy:resource transfer time to warehouses is now dependent on the mine’s depth, adding a layer of realism to resource management,
:pwwenergy:Mines now extract 2 resource units per cycle, making extraction more efficient,
:pwwenergy:improved sorting of resources for extraction, ensuring a more logical and efficient process,
:pwwenergy:after mining is complete, the mine will retain information about which resources were extracted there.

[h3][b]📋 Command Center Enhancements[/b][/h3]
:pwwenergy:resources are displayed alphabetically and grouped by size for better inventory management,
:pwwenergy:holding Shift while adding resources for shipment to the front quickly adds x10, greatly streamlining the process of managing large quantities.

[h3][b]⚙️ Endgame Optimization[/b][/h3]
:pwwenergy:key optimization work has been carried out to ensure greater stability during the late stages of gameplay.

[h3][b]🕹️ Save Game Compatibility[/b][/h3]
Your old save files will work with version 2.0. However, due to the extensive changes introduced in this update, we [b]highly recommend starting a new game[/b] to fully experience all the new features and improvements.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback – every update brings us closer to delivering the perfect gameplay experience! 

Check out the new features in version 2.0 and let us know what you think! 🎮

notes.title: Try the newest Project Wunderwaffe 1.6 version!
notes.content:
[h3]We're thrilled to share that Project Wunderwaffe has been improved to version 1.6! Take in the fantastic news we've prepared for you![/h3]

[h3][b]New in version 1.6[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]The whole Resource Management System has been rebuilt. These issues that occasionally appear have been resolved:[/b][/h3]
ːpwwenergyː duplication of resources when sending to the front,
ːpwwenergyː incorrect counting of resources in Warehouses,
ːpwwenergyː splitting resources when sending to the front from more than one Warehouse,
ːpwwenergyː random, incorrect amount of resources taken from Warehouses when loading recipes to the production queue.

[h3][b]Improvements to the Resource Management System in the base:[/b][/h3]
ːpwwenergyː the ability to send resources from production rooms to Main Warehouses has been added,
ːpwwenergyː a useful list of all available resources, accessible by the "G" key, has been added; it will show in the upper right corner of the screen.

[b]Remember that when Warehouses are full, the resources sent there are lost.[/b]

[h3][b]Gameplay changes:[/b][/h3]
ːpwwenergyː a new resource for production in the newly built cement plant: Concrete Obstacle,
ːpwwenergyː changes in the balance of some resources and production recipes.


[h3][b]What's next[/b][/h3]

We are working on solving performance difficulties that appear in the final phase of the game when there are a large number of mines in the base.

[b]Thank you very much for your support and helpful feedback, which allows us to develop the Wunderwaffe Project! [/b]

[b]Let’s play[/b]

notes.title: Play the updated Project Wunderwaffe!
notes.content:
[h2]We are excited to announce that Project Wunderwaffe has been updated to version 1.5! Take in the exciting news we have planned for you![/h2]

[h2][b]New in version 1.5[/b][/h2]

[h3]:pwwenergy:Tunnels and elevators that went into a corrupted state when something was built in between are fixed.[/h3]
[h3]:pwwenergy:From now on, you can also send to the front:
[b]Wood, Cable, TNT, Stone, Prefabricated Walls, Chemicals, Rebars.[/b][/h3]
[h3]:pwwenergy:Boxes of mined ore take up less warehousing space.[/h3]
[h3]:pwwenergy:Wood occupies less space in warehouses.[/h3]
[h3]:pwwenergy:New tasks have been added.[/h3]
[h3]:pwwenergy:Models and textures have been optimized to increase efficiency and reduce loading times.[/h3]

[h3]At the request of players who want to get 100% of their achievements, we introduced the option to manually unlock seasonal achievements. Simply press "U" during gameplay to do that.
[/h3]

[h2][b]You're probably wondering what's next[/b]

[/h2]
[h3]In the near future, we plan to add the ability to send resources from local warehouses in production buildings. But you may test this right now in the development version on the branch public_beta.[/h3]

[b][h3]To switch to the public_beta version, follow these steps:
Steam client > LIBRARY > right-click on Project Wunderwaffe > Properties > BETAS > public_beta[/h3][/b]
[h3]We will improve the entire resource information management system to completely eliminate problems that sometimes arise, such as duplication during shipment to the front and random incorrect counting of warehouse contents.[/h3]

[h3][b]Thank you for your support and helpful feedback, which allows us to continually develop the game![/b] [/h3]

[b][h3]Enjoy![/h3][/b]

[h3]:pwwenergy:Task List[/h3]
During the game, there will be a variety of tasks to do.

[b]Types of tasks:[/b]
:pwwgold:Front Orders [b] “Send to the Front”[/b]: send ordered resources to the Front
:pwwgold:Production Orders [b]“Produce”[/b]: produce ordered resources
:pwwgold:Digging Orders [b]“Dig”[/b]: dig ordered resources

Some tasks will have specific time to be completed: [b]“Time to complete”[/b].
Successful completion of tasks will result in a variety of rewards.

[b]Rewards:[/b]
:pwwgold:[b]Resources[/b] - you will receive specific resources
:pwwgold:Extra days [b]“More days”[/b] - you will be given additional days
:pwwgold:Increasing the digging speed [b]“Digging speed”[/b] - the digging speed will increase by xx% for a certain period of time
:pwwgold:Increasing the production efficiency [b]“Production”[/b] - the production efficiency will increase by xx% 
for a certain period of time

[h3]:pwwenergy:UI[/h3]
:pwwgold:The interface has been optimized and changed in appearance

[h3]:pwwenergy:Balance[/h3]
:pwwgold:Wunderwaffe weaponry push the Fronts back for more days
:pwwgold:Wunderwaffe weaponry push the Fronts back for more days, depending on difficulty level 
:pwwgold:Game balance has been changed

[h3]:pwwenergy:Quality of Life[/h3]
:pwwgold:Autosave feature has been added
:pwwgold:Information about transport reaching the Front has been added
:pwwgold:Tooltips in the Main Menu have been added

:pwwgold:Special areas on the mountain's left and right sides, assigned to the buildings: 
Missile Silo, Tank Plant, Haunebu, Additional Tunnel are visible from the beginning of the game

[h3]:pwwenergy:Fixes[/h3]
:pwwgold:Loading recipes: the bug that caused recipes to not be loaded in newly placed production buildings after loading a save has been fixed
:pwwgold:Achievements granted for shipping the A6 rocket has been fixed
:pwwgold:Production of A6 rocket has been fixed 

[h3]:pwwenergy:Optimization[/h3]
:pwwgold:The UE version has been updated

notes.title: Test it out! - Public Beta
notes.content:
[h3]We appreciate your enthusiastic response to Project Wunderwaffe! 
We are pleased to inform you that three [b]difficulty levels have been added[/b]: easy, medium, and hard.[/h3]

[b][h2]Easy level[/h2][/b]
✅time remaining - [b]120 days[/b]
✅You get [b]50%[/b] of the points compared to the hard level

[b][h2]Medium level[/h2][/b]
✅time remaining - [b]80 days[/b]
✅You get [b]75%[/b] of the points compared to the hard level

[b][h2]Hard level[/h2][/b]
✅time remaining - [b]45 days[/b]
✅You get [b]100%[/b] points!

[h3]This is not the only fantastic news-[b]after the mine is removed, the workers automatically return to their quarters.[/b] We also changed the overall balance to make your gameplay even more enjoyable.

[b]REMEMBER.[/b] The introduction of difficulty levels forces the necessity 
to change the save/load system. That is why [b]we created a branch with the Public Beta version for anyone who wants to try out new solutions!
[/b]
[b]To switch to the public_beta version, follow these steps:[/b][/h3]

[h3]Steam client > LIBRARY > right-click on Project Wunderwaffe > Properties > BETAS > public_beta[/h3]
